title.zh: 戈尔德斯格林袭击案嫌疑人被确认为埃萨·苏莱曼，此前曾被转介至“预防”计划——实时更新

summary.en: A 45-year-old British national, Essa Suleiman, has been named as the suspect in the Golders Green attack. Police confirmed he had been referred to a counterterrorism scheme in 2020, but the case was closed the same year. The suspect reportedly has a history of mental health issues, drug use, and convictions for...
summary.zh: 一名45岁的英国国民埃萨·苏莱曼被确认为戈尔德斯格林袭击案的嫌疑人。警方证实他曾在2020年被转介至一项反恐计划，但该案件同年结案。据报道，嫌疑人有精神健康问题、吸毒史和暴力犯罪前科。

body.en: Suleiman had been referred to counterterrorism scheme in 2020 but case was closed the same year Full report: Golders Green attack suspect referred to Prevent scheme in 2020, say police Here are some of the latest images from the newswires in Golders Green this morning: A 45-year-old man, who is a British national, born in Somalia, was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder. The home secretary, Shabana Mahmood, said he came to the UK lawfully as a child. The Metropolitan police said he was initially taken to hospital after being arrested but has since been discharged. He was taken to a London police station where he remains in custody. The Met commissioner, Mark Rowley, said the suspect has a history of mental health issues, drug use and convictions for violence. Continue reading...

reflection.en: News of an attack, especially one involving a suspect with a complex history, can be deeply unsettling. Romans 12:21 reminds us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively overcome evil with good. This calls us to seek effective ways to prevent violence, address underlying struggles like mental health, and foster a society where good prevails.
reflection.zh: 袭击事件的消息，尤其当嫌疑人有着复杂的背景时，可能令人深感不安。罗马书12:21提醒我们不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。这呼吁我们寻求有效的方法来预防暴力，解决精神健康等深层问题，并努力建立一个良善盛行的社会。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Israel intercepts Gaza flotilla near Crete and detains 175 activists
title.zh: 以色列在克里特岛附近拦截加沙船队，拘留175名活动家

summary.en: Pro-Palestinian activists reported that 22 boats carrying humanitarian aid for Gaza were intercepted by Israeli forces in international waters near the Greek island of Crete, leading to the detention of 175 individuals.
summary.zh: 亲巴勒斯坦活动家报告称，22艘载有加沙人道主义援助物资的船只在希腊克里特岛附近的国际水域被以色列军队拦截，导致175人被拘留。

reflection.en: The efforts of activists to deliver aid to those in need highlight a deep human impulse to care for the vulnerable. Isaiah 58:7 reminds us that true devotion involves practical compassion: sharing food with the hungry, sheltering the poor, and clothing the naked. In times of conflict and blockade, the call to extend help to those suffering remains a...
reflection.zh: 活动家们向有需要的人运送援助的努力，凸显了人类关怀弱者的深层冲动。以赛亚书58:7提醒我们，真正的虔诚包括实际的怜悯：与饥饿的人分享食物，为贫困的流浪者提供住所，并给赤身露体的人穿衣。在冲突和封锁时期，向受苦者伸出援手仍然是一项深刻的道德责任。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

reflection.en: The news of stalled peace talks and escalating threats reminds us of the constant challenge to live peacefully in a complex world. Romans 12:18 calls us to pursue peace as much as lies within our power, acknowledging that while perfect peace may not always be fully attainable, the effort to foster understanding and de-escalate tensions remains a vital...
reflection.zh: 关于和谈停滞和威胁升级的消息，提醒我们生活在一个复杂世界中，和平共处面临着持续的挑战。罗马书12:18呼吁我们，只要力所能及，就与众人和睦，这承认了虽然完美的和平并非总能完全实现，但促进理解和缓和紧张局势的努力仍然是一项重要的呼召。在全球局势日益紧张的时刻，这节经文鼓励我们尽可能寻求和解与对话的途径。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Starmer calls on public to ‘open their eyes to Jewish pain’ in wake of Golders Green attack
title.zh: 斯塔默呼吁公众在戈尔德斯格林袭击事件后“正视犹太人的痛苦”

summary.en: The prime minister urged people to acknowledge "Jewish pain" after a terror attack in Golders Green and criticized those marching with Hamas supporters for "venerating the murder of Jews." He made these remarks after meeting emergency workers and community leaders.
summary.zh: 首相在戈尔德斯格林恐怖袭击后，呼吁人们“正视犹太人的痛苦”，并指责那些与哈马斯支持者同行的人是“崇拜谋杀犹太人”。他在会见紧急救援人员和社区领袖后发表了这些言论。

body.en: The prime minister also accused anyone marching alongside Hamas supporters of ‘venerating the murder of Jews’ Golders Green attack – latest updates Keir Starmer has called on people to “open their eyes to Jewish pain” in the wake of the Golders Green terror attack, and accused anyone marching alongside supporters of Hamas of “venerating the murder of Jews”. The prime minister made his strongest ever remarks on antisemitism after visiting the area of the attacks for a meeting with emergency workers and community leaders. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The prime minister's call to "open their eyes to Jewish pain" echoes the timeless challenge of the Good Samaritan. In a world often divided by conflict and prejudice, this story reminds us to see the suffering of our neighbors, especially those targeted by hatred, and to respond with compassion rather than indifference or complicity.
reflection.zh: 首相呼吁“正视犹太人的痛苦”，这与好撒玛利亚人的永恒挑战不谋而合。在一个常被冲突和偏见分裂的世界里，这个故事提醒我们，要看到邻舍的痛苦，特别是那些被仇恨所针对的人，并以怜悯而非冷漠或同谋来回应。

verse.textEn: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers? ... 'Go and do likewise.'
verse.textZh: 你想这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？……「你去照样行吧。」

He was referred to the scheme in 2020 and cleared within six weeks, six years before allegedly stabbing two Jewish men. The Prevent scheme has faced criticism for its...

His case was referred to Prevent in 2020 and closed within six weeks by the deradicalisation scheme, which has faced previous criticism for being ineffective. Continue reading...

reflection.en: This news highlights the persistent challenge of extremism and the difficulty of preventing violence rooted in harmful ideologies. When any ideology or cause demands ultimate loyalty, it can become an 'other god' that distorts human dignity and leads to destructive acts. We are reminded to examine where our ultimate allegiances lie and to seek true peace.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了极端主义的持续挑战，以及预防源于有害意识形态的暴力行为的难度。当任何意识形态或事业要求绝对忠诚时，它就可能成为“别的神”，扭曲人性尊严并导致破坏性行为。这提醒我们审视自己的最终效忠对象，并寻求真正的平安。

verse.textEn: You shall have no other gods before me.
verse.textZh: 除了我以外，你不可有别的神。

body.en: State’s governor and attorney general move to postpone midterm 2026 primaries just a day after supreme court ruling guts Voting Rights Act Louisiana postpones primaries as states rush to redraw districts after supreme court ruling The Voting Rights Act was a political peace compact written in John Lewis’s blood. The Callais v Landry decision by the US supreme court , which set aside much of section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, whitewashed that blood from history, along with that of thousands of other Americans who fought segregationist white supremacists at lunch counters and bus stations and courthouses for political equality. reflection.en: The tightening blockade and recent violence leave many wondering about their safety and future, echoing the cry, "How are we going to get back home?" In such times of deep uncertainty and trouble, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in distress. This promise offers a steadfast anchor when the world around us feels...
reflection.zh: 随着封锁的加剧和近期暴力事件的发生，许多人对他们的安全和未来感到担忧，这与“我们怎么才能回家？”的呼声不谋而合。在这样充满不确定和困境的时刻，诗篇46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。当周围的世界感到不稳定和充满威胁时，这个应许提供了一个坚定的锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

body.en: Exclusive: Government should back projects that prioritise renewables to protect consumers from ongoing price shocks, they say Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Former oil and gas industry leaders, including senior executives from BP and Shell, are warning the Albanese government that Australians risk ongoing price shocks and higher costs if it prioritises fossil fuel development in response to the global energy crisis. Sixteen ex-executives and professionals – who had worked for companies including Woodside, Inpex, Exxon Mobil and Esso – have urged the government to reject calls for fast-tracked gas and coal extraction, arguing it would do nothing to improve the nation’s liquid fuel security.
